description: This file defines the HeaderProcessor class within the GuzzleHttp library, responsible for parsing HTTP headers from an array of header lines. It provides a static method parseHeaders to extract the HTTP version, status code, reason phrase, and headers.

classes.name: HeaderProcessor
classes.description: A final class responsible for processing HTTP headers

methods.name: parseHeaders
methods.description: Parses an array of header lines to extract HTTP version, status code, reason phrase, and headers
